name: Hospitality Exploration Summer Camp 2027
org: UNLV William F. Harrah College of Hospitality
what_you_do: Live on the UNLV campus for a week. You do hands on activities and field trips. You hear talks from teachers and leaders in the hotel and travel business.
who_can_apply: Current high school students with a 3.0 or higher cumulative GPA. Juniors and seniors get preference.
pay_detail: $850, includes meals and on-campus housing. Scholarships available: email kaila.seidler@unlv.edu.
deadline_text: Registration deadline to be announced ("coming soon"). Camp is June 21 to 25, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form linked on the page. If you have questions, send an email to hospitalityadmissions@unlv.edu.
notes: The page says both a 3.0 GPA rule and that any current high school student can attend. Ask the college which applies.
